finding.transcript_evidence: Sir, I can assure you that you will definitely get a 15% return on this. No doubt about it.
finding.regulation_clause_text:
g. MFDs shall (i) not provide any indicative portfolio or indicative yield or indicative return
for any particular scheme or transaction and (ii) abstain from indicating or assuring 
returns for any particular scheme or transaction.
finding.reasoning: The RM explicitly provided an assured return guarantee of 15% using definitive language ('definitely get', 'assure you', 'no doubt about it'). This constitutes a direct violation of AMFI regulations which explicitly prohibit MFDs from indicating or assuring returns for any particular scheme or transaction. The statement creates false expectations and misleads the investor about the nature of mutual fund investments.
finding.recommended_action: Immediate coaching on prohibited return assurances, mandatory retraining on AMFI compliance requirements, and customer follow-up to clarify that mutual fund returns are not guaranteed.

finding.reasoning: The RM pitched ARGUS Large Cap Equity Fund (Medium risk class) to a customer without providing ANY mandatory risk disclosures. SEBI regulations require risk-o-meter disclosure and market-risk warnings for Medium risk products. The RM made performance claims and sought immediate investment without disclosing the risk-o-meter, volatility warnings, or any risk-related information. This constitutes a complete absence of mandatory disclosure requirements for a Medium risk mutual fund product.
finding.recommended_action: Immediate training on mandatory disclosure requirements for Medium/High risk products and supervisory review of all pending transactions by this RM.
